```{r}
#| label: params
# Banner:  header band from dashboard/header_common.html; the rerun banner comes from cfg("dashboard_banner") in the howto chunk.
# Purpose: one-page dashboard of the BMV unmix comparison rerun on common SpectroFlo gates. One copy serves
#          3d, 24h and exv (SW_DATASET). Sections follow the new INDEX; every figure the INDEX cites is shown as its 300-dpi PNG,
#          the Conclusions bullets carry theirs, and a cited figure with no file stops the render.
# Run:     SW_DATASET=3d SW_RUN_DATE=YYYY-MM-DD pixi run quarto render experiments/benchmarks/05_bmv-unmix-compare/96c_dashboard.qmd   (repo root)
#          SW_DATASET (3d, 24h, exv) and SW_RUN_DATE are required. SW_OUT_NAME (optional) names the output folder
#          under experiments/runs; unset, it is run_out("dashboard-common").
#          then mv the rendered dashboard_common.html to OUT_DIR/dashboard.html (the render creates OUT_DIR).
# Inputs:  run_in("summary-common")/INDEX.md     text, verbatim (registry: datasets/<ds>_runs.csv)
#          run_in("summary-common")/CHANGES.md   the "What changed" table
#          dashboard/figs_common.py              figure list, resolved through run_in("restyle-common")/MANIFEST_restyle_common.csv
#          dashboard/artifact/cards_common.json (3d) or cards_<ds>.json (24h, exv)   headline cards
#          datasets/<ds>.json key dashboard_subject; datasets/<ds>_samples.csv (donor list)
#          <figure>.csv beside every cited PNG                         plotted data
# Outputs: <OUT_DIR>/figures.csv       section, figure, kind (restyled, cited, run-dir), caption
#          <OUT_DIR>/sessionInfo.txt
# Parameters --------------------------------------------------------------------
RUNS_DIR <- "experiments/runs"
FIGS_PY <- "experiments/benchmarks/05_bmv-unmix-compare/dashboard/figs_common.py"
CARDS_DIR <- "experiments/benchmarks/05_bmv-unmix-compare/dashboard/artifact"
SKIP_SECTIONS <- "^08" # 08 points at the superseded offline dashboard this page replaces
MAX_ROWS <- 500 # rows shown per data table; larger tables show the first MAX_ROWS
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("../../.."))
```

```{r}
#| label: libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(reactable)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: dataset
# Dataset paths ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# dataset.R reads SW_DATASET and stops when it is unset; run_in() stops on an unregistered key.
source("experiments/benchmarks/05_bmv-unmix-compare/datasets/dataset.R")
INDEX_MD <- file.path(run_in("summary-common"), "INDEX.md")
CHANGES_MD <- file.path(run_in("summary-common"), "CHANGES.md")
CARDS_JSON <- file.path(CARDS_DIR, if (DS$dataset == "3d") "cards_common.json" else paste0("cards_", DS$dataset, ".json"))
OUT_DIR <- if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("SW_OUT_NAME"))) file.path(RUNS_DIR, Sys.getenv("SW_OUT_NAME")) else run_out("dashboard-common") # SW_OUT_NAME renders into a named dir
# Replicate units named in the reading note: 3d and exv have one file per well (condition NA), 24h has conditions per donor.
DONORS <- if (is.null(DS$conditions)) sort(samples_tbl()$sample) else sort(unique(samples_tbl()$donor))
```

```{r}
#| label: figures
# Figures cited by the INDEX -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# figs_common.py resolves each citation (restyled copy first, run-dir path otherwise) and exits non-zero
# when a cited figure has no file. The PNGs are already 300 dpi, so they are linked, not copied.
stopifnot("output dir is new" = !dir.exists(OUT_DIR))
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
figs_csv <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "figures.csv")
status <- system2("python3", c(FIGS_PY, figs_csv))
stopifnot("a cited figure has no file (see the message above)" = status == 0)
figures <- read_csv(figs_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(src = file.path(RUNS_DIR, path), line_no = line_no + 1L) # python line numbers are 0-based
stopifnot("every cited figure exists" = all(file.exists(figures$src)))

# One row per "## " section of the INDEX; section_idx counts them from 0 like figs_common.py.
index <- read_lines(INDEX_MD)
heading_at <- which(str_detect(index, "^## "))
sections <- tibble(
  section_idx = seq_along(heading_at) - 1L,
  start = heading_at,
  end = c(heading_at[-1] - 1, length(index)),
  heading = str_remove(index[heading_at], "^## ")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
# The plotted data of one figure: the source CSV saved beside the PNG.
data_table <- \(png) {
  csv <- str_replace(png, "\\.png$", ".csv")
  if (!file.exists(csv)) {
    return(list(widget = NULL, note = "No source table was saved beside this figure; it is drawn from per-event data."))
  }
  d <- read_csv(csv, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 5000)
  n <- nrow(d)
  d <- d |>
    head(MAX_ROWS) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) signif(x, 3)))
  note <- if (n > MAX_ROWS) sprintf("First %d of %d rows; full table: `%s`.", MAX_ROWS, n, csv) else sprintf("%d rows; file: `%s`.", n, csv)
  list(
    widget = reactable(
      d,
      searchable = TRUE,
      sortable = TRUE,
      compact = TRUE,
      striped = TRUE,
      defaultPageSize = 10,
      wrap = FALSE,
      resizable = TRUE
    ),
    note = note
  )
}

# Image line of one figure; the alt text is escaped so a "[...]" in a caption does not end it.
image_md <- \(caption, path, src) {
  alt <- str_replace_all(sprintf("%s `%s`", caption, path), "([\\[\\]])", "\\\\\\1")
  sprintf("![%s](%s){width=100%%}\n", alt, file.path("../../..", src))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cards
#| results: asis
# Headline cards ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The card values come from INDEX text (cards_common.json).
cards <- jsonlite::read_json(CARDS_JSON)
if (!is.null(names(cards))) cards <- cards$cards # cards_<ds>.json is {"cards": [...]}; the 3D file is a bare list
card_html <- map_chr(cards, \(c) {
  sprintf(
    '  <div class="verdict %s">\n    <div class="v-label">%s</div>\n    <div class="v-value">%s</div>\n    <div class="v-note">%s</div>\n  </div>',
    c$state, htmltools::htmlEscape(c$label), htmltools::htmlEscape(c$value), htmltools::htmlEscape(c$note)
  )
})
cat(
  '\n```{=html}\n<div class="verdict-row">\n', paste(card_html, collapse = "\n"), "\n</div>\n```\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

```{r}
#| label: howto
#| results: asis
# Rerun banner from the dataset config (dashboard/header_common.html carries no banner).
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="rerun-banner"><strong>%s</strong><a href="#what-changed">What changed: every old claim against its new value</a></div>\n\n',
  cfg("dashboard_banner")
))
# Subtitle and reading note; the subject text is the dataset config, the donor list comes from the sample table.
cat(sprintf('<p class="subtitle">AutoSpectral 1.0.2 vs 1.8.8 on %s, %d donors: common SpectroFlo gates</p>\n\n', cfg("dashboard_subject"), length(DONORS)))
cat(sprintf(
  '> **How to read this page.** Each section states the finding, then shows its figures (300-dpi PNG, Nature spec) and the data behind each figure (sortable and searchable). Conclusions carry their figures under each bullet. Arms are the unmixing setups compared; donors (%s) are the replicates. "Losing most of the spike" means less than half of a +1 arcsinh spike is recovered in a cell. The tab "What changed" lists every old claim against its new value.\n',
  paste(DONORS, collapse = ", ")
))
```

```{r}
#| label: intro
#| results: asis
# The status paragraphs of INDEX.md above its first section, verbatim.
cat(index[2:(heading_at[1] - 1)], sep = "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: body
#| results: asis
# One section per INDEX heading ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Built as child markdown so each reactable keeps its HTML dependencies. Conclusions put each bullet's figures
# right under it; other sections show the prose, then tabs for the figures and their data.
render_section <- \(sec) {
  body <- index[(sec$start + 1):sec$end]
  figs <- filter(figures, section_idx == sec$section_idx)
  lines <- c(sprintf("## %s", sec$heading), "")
  if (sec$heading == "Conclusions") {
    first <- which(str_detect(body, "^- "))
    ends <- c(first[-1] - 1, length(body))
    lines <- c(lines, body[seq_len(first[1] - 1)])
    for (k in seq_along(first)) {
      lines <- c(lines, body[first[k]:ends[k]], "")
      in_bullet <- between(figs$line_no, sec$start + first[k], sec$start + ends[k])
      lines <- c(lines, pmap_chr(figs[in_bullet, ], \(caption, path, src, ...) image_md(caption, path, src)))
    }
  } else {
    lines <- c(lines, body, "")
    if (nrow(figs) > 0) {
      lines <- c(lines, "::: {.panel-tabset}", "", "### Figures", "")
      lines <- c(lines, pmap_chr(figs, \(caption, path, src, ...) image_md(caption, path, src)))
      lines <- c(lines, "### Data", "")
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(figs))) {
        lines <- c(
          lines,
          sprintf("**%s**", basename(figs$path[i])),
          "",
          sprintf("```{r, results='asis'}\ntab <- data_table(%s)\ncat(tab$note)\n```\n", deparse(figs$src[i])),
          "```{r}\ntab$widget\n```\n"
        )
      }
      lines <- c(lines, ":::", "")
    }
  }
  knitr::knit_child(text = lines, envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE)
}
not_dashboard <- filter(sections, str_detect(heading, SKIP_SECTIONS), !str_detect(heading, regex("dashboard", ignore_case = TRUE)))
stopifnot(
  "96c_dashboard.qmd: the section skipped by SKIP_SECTIONS is not the superseded dashboard section" = nrow(not_dashboard) == 0
)
out <- pmap_chr(filter(sections, !str_detect(heading, SKIP_SECTIONS)), \(...) render_section(tibble(...)))
cat(out, sep = "\n\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: what-changed
#| results: asis
# CHANGES.md as a table; its title line is dropped because the section heading names it.
cat("## What changed {#what-changed}\n\n")
cat(read_lines(CHANGES_MD)[-1], sep = "\n")
```

#| label: session
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(OUT_DIR, "sessionInfo.txt"))
